lines.en: The rope is in my chest. The winch is on the landing. The rest is hands.
lines.zh: 绳子在我箱子里，绞盘在码头上。剩下的就看手了。

lines.en: Thirty-one years I have kept this crossing. The river has never once asked my leave.
lines.zh: 我守这个渡口三十一年了。河水从来没问过我一声。

lines.en: Aldo built that winch. Built the raft too. The river took him the spring after. I stayed.
lines.zh: 那个绞盘是阿尔多造的，筏子也是。第二年春天河水把他带走了。我留了下来。

lines.en: Aldo and Joss built the footbridge, twenty years back. A rider in white took it apart in one night, and laid the nails on my pier.
lines.zh: 那座小桥是阿尔多和乔斯二十年前一起造的。一个白衣骑手一夜之间就把它拆了，还把钉子摆在我的码头上。

lines.en: That tree at the narrows has been dead ten years. Aldo always said it would fall the wrong way.
lines.zh: 窄处那棵树枯了十年了。阿尔多总说它会往不该倒的方向倒。

text.en: Storm took the ferry rope in the night. Nobody crosses till it's mended. … There's a spare in my chest. My hands won't splice it any more — yours might.
text.zh: 夜里的风暴把渡绳扯断了。不修好，谁也过不去。……我箱子里有根备用的。我这双手接不动绳子了——你的手也许行。

text.zh: 绳子在我箱子里，绞盘在码头上。剩下的就看手了。

text.zh: 那座小桥是阿尔多和乔斯二十年前一起造的。一个白衣骑手一夜之间就把它拆了，还把钉子摆在我的码头上。

text.en: The evenings come sooner every week. I light the lamp earlier and earlier.
text.zh: 天黑得一周比一周早。我点灯也越来越早。

text.en: The rider is down? ...I will build the bridge again, then. Properly, this time.
text.zh: 那个骑手倒下了？……那我就再把桥修起来。这回要修得结结实实的。

text.en: That tree at the narrows has been dead ten years. Aldo always said it would fall the wrong way.
text.zh: 窄处那棵树枯了十年了。阿尔多总说它会往不该倒的方向倒。

text.en: Water is high. It will be high all day.
text.zh: 水涨着呢。今天一整天都会这么高。

text.en: Keep near the fire after dark. Things come up out of the hollow.
text.zh: 天黑了就待在火边。会有东西从洞里爬出来。

text.en: … Go to sleep.
text.zh: ……去睡吧。

text.en: Get under something. Lightning likes that dead tree.
text.zh: 找个地方躲着。闪电专挑那棵枯树。

text.en: Rain. Good for the fire risk, bad for my knees.
text.zh: 下雨了。火是不容易烧起来了，我的膝盖可受罪。

text.en: The line holds. When you are ready, say so, and I will take you over.
text.zh: 绳子稳住了。你准备好了就说一声，我送你过去。

text.en: Well. Aldo was wrong — it fell the right way after all.
text.zh: 好吧。阿尔多说错了——它到底还是往对的方向倒了。

text.en: Tobin gave you something off that cart? Then he was hungrier than he is proud.
text.zh: 托宾从他车上给了你东西？看来他饿得连面子都不要了。

text.en: I saw that. Put it back when you are done with it.
text.zh: 我看见了。用完了放回去。

text.en: Good hands. Better than mine now.
text.zh: 手巧。比我现在强。

text.en: Eat it yourself. … Fine. Thank you.
text.zh: 你自己吃吧。……好吧，谢谢。

text.en: Not to me. To the winch.
text.zh: 别给我。给绞盘。

text.en: What would I do with that?
text.zh: 我要这个干什么？

lines.en: I'd trade the whole cart for a hot meal. Well — not the whole cart. Most of it.
lines.zh: 为了一顿热饭，我愿意拿整车货来换。嗯——也不是整车。大半车吧。

lines.en: That blue wand? Frost from the tip. Freezes a puddle solid. A river, I would not know — never tried.
lines.zh: 那根蓝魔杖？杖尖冒寒气，能把水洼冻得结结实实。河嘛，我不知道——没试过。

lines.en: Hesper says I owe her a fare. I say the river owes us both. She doesn't laugh.
lines.zh: 赫斯珀说我欠她一趟船钱。我说是河欠我们俩的。她不笑。

lines.en: Oil, a flask of it. Burns hot and slick. Useful, if you are careful. I am not careful.
lines.zh: 灯油，一瓶。烧得又旺又滑。小心点用很有用。我就不小心。

lines.en: I sold a frost charm to a man in grey last winter. Paid in old coin — no king on it. Never seen coin like it. Kept one for luck.
lines.zh: 去年冬天我卖了个寒霜护符给一个穿灰衣服的人。他用旧钱币付的——上面没有国王。我从没见过那样的钱。留了一枚图个吉利。

ties.npc.hesper: the ferrykeeper he owes a fare

text.en: Welcome to Firstlight Village! Tobin, of the eastern road. Charms, oils, oddments — the ferry is still broken, so I brought the cart here. You wouldn't have anything to eat?
text.zh: 欢迎来初原村！我叫托宾，跑东边那条路的。护符、灯油、杂货——渡船还没修好，我就把货车搬来了。你身上没带点吃的吧？

text.en: I'd trade the whole cart for a hot meal. Well — not the whole cart. Most of it.
text.zh: 为了一顿热饭，我愿意拿整车货来换。嗯——也不是整车。大半车吧。

text.en: That blue wand? Frost from the tip. Freezes a puddle solid. A river, I would not know — never tried.
text.zh: 那根蓝魔杖？杖尖冒寒气，能把水洼冻得结结实实。河嘛，我不知道——没试过。

text.en: Hesper says I owe her a fare. I say the river owes us both. She doesn't laugh.
text.zh: 赫斯珀说我欠她一趟船钱。我说是河欠我们俩的。她不笑。

text.en: Oil, a flask of it. Burns hot and slick. Useful, if you are careful. I am not careful.
text.zh: 灯油，一瓶。烧得又旺又滑。小心点用很有用。我就不小心。

text.en: I sold a frost charm to a man in grey last winter. Paid in old coin — no king on it. Never seen coin like it. Kept one for luck.
text.zh: 去年冬天我卖了个寒霜护符给一个穿灰衣服的人。他用旧钱币付的——上面没有国王。我从没见过那样的钱。留了一枚图个吉利。

text.en: The man in grey? The frost charm! That is how he crossed — oh, Hesper will never forgive me for that one.
text.zh: 那个灰衣人？寒霜护符！他就是靠那个过的河——哦，赫斯珀永远不会原谅我这件事了。

text.en: The village fire is warm. Better than sleeping by the hollow at the Ford, with one eye open.
text.zh: 村里的火暖和。总比睡在渡口洞边、还得睁一只眼强。

text.en: Shh. Did you hear that? … Probably nothing. Probably.
text.zh: 嘘。你听见了吗？……大概没什么。大概。

text.en: Not under the tree! Never under the tree in a storm. My uncle — well. Never mind my uncle.
text.zh: 别站树底下！打雷的时候千万别站树底下。我叔叔他——算了，别提我叔叔了。

text.en: Rain on the charms. They do not like it. Neither do I.
text.zh: 雨淋到护符了。它们不喜欢，我也不喜欢。

text.en: Go on, take the wand off the cart. A deal is a deal, and that bread was a very good deal.
text.zh: 去吧，把魔杖从车上拿走。说好的就是说好的，那块面包可太划算了。

text.en: The line is mended? Then Hesper will take you — and maybe me, if I promise to pay. Again.
text.zh: 渡绳接上了？那赫斯珀会送你过去——说不定也送我，只要我再保证一次会付钱。

text.en: You felled the dead tree! Across the river! I'll be telling that one in every inn from here to the coast.
text.zh: 你把枯树砍倒了！横在河上！这件事我要从这儿一路讲到海边的每家客栈。

text.en: I saw that. I'm a peddler — I always see that.
text.zh: 我看见了。我是货郎——这种事我总能看见。

text.en: Oh — oh, thank you. Two days. Two whole days.
text.zh: 哦——哦，谢谢你。两天了。整整两天。

text.en: For me? I'll find a buyer for it somewhere. I always do.
text.zh: 给我的？我总能给它找到买主。一向如此。

lines.en: Keep the buckets full. That is all the advice I have, and it is not enough.
lines.zh: 把水桶都装满。我能给的忠告就这一句，而且远远不够。

lines.en: Cinder Peak used to be a name for a mountain. Now it is a name for a fear.
lines.zh: 烬峰以前只是座山的名字。现在成了害怕的代名词。

ties.npc.garrick: the smith she trusts with the village gate
ties.npc.wren: the herbalist she taught her letters

text.en: Keep the buckets full. That is all the advice I have, and it is not enough.
text.zh: 把水桶都装满。我能给的忠告就这一句，而且远远不够。

text.en: Cinder Peak used to be a name for a mountain. Now it is a name for a fear.
text.zh: 烬峰以前只是座山的名字。现在成了害怕的代名词。

text.en: Garrick has forged it, then. I heard the hammer all night.
text.zh: 加里克锻好了。我听了一夜的锤子声。

text.en: Wren's draught. Drink it at the lair's mouth, not before — it does not last.
text.zh: 雷恩的药剂。到巢穴门口再喝，别早喝——药效不长。

text.en: You did it. I will have your name cut into the well. Do not argue.
text.zh: 你做到了。我要把你的名字刻在井上。别跟我争。

text.en: For the village? Thank you.
text.zh: 给镇子的？谢谢你。

lines.en: Five iron ore and three coal. The old mine north of the square has both, and things that bite.
lines.zh: 五块铁矿石，三块煤。广场北边的旧矿坑两样都有，还有会咬人的东西。

lines.en: A pickaxe breaks a vein in two blows. Do not let the cyclops see you do it.
lines.zh: 镐子敲两下就能敲开矿脉。别让独眼巨人看见你在敲。

ties.npc.mara: the elder who pays for his coal

text.en: Smith. Garrick. If you are here about the dragon, everyone is. If you are here about a horseshoe, you are the first this month.
text.zh: 铁匠，加里克。要是为了魔龙来的——大家都是。要是为了马掌来的，你是这个月头一个。

text.en: Five iron ore and three coal. The old mine north of the square has both, and things that bite.
text.zh: 五块铁矿石，三块煤。广场北边的旧矿坑两样都有，还有会咬人的东西。

text.en: A pickaxe breaks a vein in two blows. Do not let the cyclops see you do it.
text.zh: 镐子敲两下就能敲开矿脉。别让独眼巨人看见你在敲。

text.en: Swing it like you mean it. It was made to mean it.
text.zh: 挥剑要用真力气。它生来就是干这个的。

text.en: Hm. I will find a use for it.
text.zh: 嗯。我会给它找个用处的。

lines.en: Fireweed grows in open meadow; frostcap in the shade of the forest. Three of each, and I can brew against fire.
lines.zh: 火焰草长在开阔的草原上，霜盖菇长在森林的阴凉处。各三份，我就能熬出防火的药。

lines.en: The books say dragons call their young when they are hurt. The books do not say what to do about it.
lines.zh: 书上说，龙受了伤会召唤幼龙。书上没说该怎么办。

ties.npc.mara: the elder who taught her letters

text.en: Oh! A traveller. Wren — herbs, salves, the occasional explosion. Mind the cauldron.
text.zh: 哦！一位旅人。我叫雷恩——草药、药膏，偶尔炸个锅。小心别碰到锅。

text.en: Fireweed grows in open meadow; frostcap in the shade of the forest. Three of each, and I can brew against fire.
text.zh: 火焰草长在开阔的草原上，霜盖菇长在森林的阴凉处。各三份，我就能熬出防火的药。

text.en: The books say dragons call their young when they are hurt. The books do not say what to do about it.
text.zh: 书上说，龙受了伤会召唤幼龙。书上没说该怎么办。

text.en: One at the lair's mouth, one when the first wears thin. And come back.
text.zh: 巢穴门口喝一瓶，第一瓶快没效了再喝第二瓶。还有——要回来。

text.en: For my shelves? Thank you!
text.zh: 给我的架子添货？谢谢！

lines.en: Pick a road and walk it. Change your mind if you must — but you start that road again from the first step.
lines.zh: 选一条路，就走下去。真要改也行——只是新路得从头走起。

lines.en: A dagger from behind. A sword and a shield from the front. An arrow from afar. A spell from wherever you stand. Which are you?
lines.zh: 匕首从背后，剑盾从正面，箭从远处，法术从你站着的地方。你是哪一种？

lines.en: Tobin talks through every drill. I have stopped telling him.
lines.zh: 托宾每次操练都在旁边说个不停。我已经懒得说他了。

ties.npc.tobin: the peddler who talks through his drills

text.en: Off the mountain, are you. Come back when you have a few fights in you — level five — and I will set you on a road: dagger, sword and shield, bow or staff.
text.zh: 从山上下来的？等你打过几场像样的仗——五级——再来找我，我给你指条路：匕首、剑盾、弓，还是法杖。

text.en: Pick a road and walk it. Change your mind if you must — but you start that road again from the first step.
text.zh: 选一条路，就走下去。真要改也行——只是新路得从头走起。

text.en: A dagger from behind. A sword and a shield from the front. An arrow from afar. A spell from wherever you stand. Which are you?
text.zh: 匕首从背后，剑盾从正面，箭从远处，法术从你站着的地方。你是哪一种？

text.en: Tobin talks through every drill. I have stopped telling him.
text.zh: 托宾每次操练都在旁边说个不停。我已经懒得说他了。

text.en: Light is going. Practise your footwork; it does not need light.
text.zh: 天要黑了。练练步法吧，步法不用看。

text.en: Rain makes the grip slip. Learn to hold on anyway.
text.zh: 下雨手会打滑。照样得学会握紧。

text.en: Keep it. Gifts do not make a fighter.
text.zh: 留着吧。礼物成就不了战士。

lines.en: A rider took the bridge and the storm took the rest. Two of ours went into the barrow and the dead keep them there — the dead do not lie down any more.
lines.zh: 骑手拆了桥，风暴带走了其余的。我们有两个人躲进了古墓，被那里的亡灵困住了——死人如今都不肯安息了。

lines.en: Firstlight looks after its own. Today, that means asking you.
lines.zh: 初原村向来自己照顾自己。可今天，只能拜托你了。

text.en: A rider took the bridge and the storm took the rest. Two of ours went into the barrow and the dead keep them there — the dead do not lie down any more.
text.zh: 骑手拆了桥，风暴带走了其余的。我们有两个人躲进了古墓，被那里的亡灵困住了——死人如今都不肯安息了。

text.en: The Firstlight has burned since before the houses. A heretic walked in and carried it off, and we let him. We let him.
text.zh: 初火比这些房子烧得还久。一个异端走进来就把它拿走了，而我们就让他拿走了。就让他拿走了。

text.en: The Church has called you. Go with our blessing — and if you see that grey thief on the road, remember what he took.
text.zh: 教会召唤了你。带着我们的祝福去吧——要是在路上遇见那个灰衣贼，别忘了他拿走了什么。

text.en: A crown of thorns in our village and a cold altar under it. The Five teach patience. I find I have very little.
text.zh: 我们村里有了荆棘冠，祭坛却是冷的。五苦教人忍耐。我发现我的耐心所剩无几。

text.en: Firstlight looks after its own. Today, that means asking you.
text.zh: 初原村向来自己照顾自己。可今天，只能拜托你了。

lines.en: A pot with nothing in it is just a hat for the fire.
lines.zh: 锅里没东西，就只是给火戴的帽子。

lines.en: Pell and his grey man. Stories, stories. He got that from his father, who went east and did not write.
lines.zh: 佩尔和他的灰衣人。故事，全是故事。他这毛病是跟他爹学的——他爹往东去了，再没来过信。

text.en: A pot with nothing in it is just a hat for the fire.
text.zh: 锅里没东西，就只是给火戴的帽子。

text.en: Sit, eat. It isn't much, but it's hot.
text.zh: 坐下吃吧。东西不多，但是热乎。

text.en: Pell and his grey man. Stories, stories. He got that from his father, who went east and did not write.
text.zh: 佩尔和他的灰衣人。故事，全是故事。他这毛病是跟他爹学的——他爹往东去了，再没来过信。

lines.en: I'm not supposed to go past the forest. I didn't. Much.
lines.zh: 我不该跑到森林那边去的。我没去。也就……去了一点点。

lines.en: Do frogs sleep? This one doesn't.
lines.zh: 青蛙睡觉吗？这只不睡。

text.en: I'm not supposed to go past the forest. I didn't. Much.
text.zh: 我不该跑到森林那边去的。我没去。也就……去了一点点。

text.en: Do frogs sleep? This one doesn't.
text.zh: 青蛙睡觉吗？这只不睡。

lines.en: Peace inside the fence. Past the grassland, keep your blade out — and after dark, keep it out everywhere.
lines.zh: 围栏里是太平的。过了草原就把刀拔出来——天黑以后，哪儿都得拔着。

text.en: Peace inside the fence. Past the grassland, keep your blade out — and after dark, keep it out everywhere.
text.zh: 围栏里是太平的。过了草原就把刀拔出来——天黑以后，哪儿都得拔着。

text.en: Hear that shuffling? The dead walk the wild at night. Not here, though. Never here.
text.zh: 听见那拖着脚的声音没？夜里荒野上有亡灵游荡。不过不会进村，从来不会。

text.en: I had him. I had him at the length of my spear, and he looked at me like I was a child, and walked away on the water.
text.zh: 我差点就抓住他了。他就在我长矛够得着的地方，他看我的眼神像在看个孩子，然后踩着水走了。

text.en: When you go on east, I want to come. Someone has to catch that thief.
text.zh: 你接着往东走的时候，我想跟着去。总得有人抓住那个贼。

lines.en: Every day the fire eats. Every day I feed it. My back has opinions about this.
lines.zh: 火天天都要吃，我天天都得喂。我的腰对此很有意见。

text.en: Every day the fire eats. Every day I feed it. My back has opinions about this.
text.zh: 火天天都要吃，我天天都得喂。我的腰对此很有意见。

lines.en: Thank you for coming. I'd almost stopped counting the days.
lines.zh: 谢谢你来找我。我都快不数日子了。

text.en: Thank you for coming. I'd almost stopped counting the days.
text.zh: 谢谢你来找我。我都快不数日子了。

text.en: I still dream of that barrow. But the herbs don't tend themselves.
text.zh: 我还会梦见那座古墓。可草药不会自己长好。

text.en: Someone shut the inner door on us. A grey man. But he left bread by the door with an ash mark on it. I don't understand.
text.zh: 有人从外面把里面那道门关上了。是个灰衣人。可他在门边留了面包，上面有个灰印。我想不明白。

lines.en: Took you long enough. Well — thank you.
lines.zh: 来得够慢的。好吧——谢谢你。

text.en: Took you long enough. Well — thank you.
text.zh: 来得够慢的。好吧——谢谢你。

text.en: Baskets don't mend themselves, and neither do old men. Both take time.
text.zh: 篮子不会自己补好，老头子也一样。都得慢慢来。

text.en: The dead in there would not lie down. I have buried my share. They always lay down before.
text.zh: 那里面的死人不肯躺下。我也埋过不少人了。以前他们总是会躺下的。

lines.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment. It is the proof the debt is being paid. That is what the Five teach.
lines.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。苦难，是灾厄得以被偿还的证明。五苦是这样教导的。

lines.en: The flame is older than the houses. The houses were built to keep it company.
lines.zh: 火比房子还老。房子是为了陪它才盖起来的。

text.en: Welcome to Firstlight, traveller. The flame you see was lit from the first dawn after the First Night. We keep it company.
text.zh: 欢迎来到初原村，旅人。你看到的这团火，取自初夜之后的第一道晨光。我们陪着它。

text.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment. It is the proof the debt is being paid. That is what the Five teach.
text.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。苦难，是灾厄得以被偿还的证明。五苦是这样教导的。

text.en: The flame is older than the houses. The houses were built to keep it company.
text.zh: 火比房子还老。房子是为了陪它才盖起来的。

text.en: The evenings come sooner. I light the lamps a little earlier every week, and I write it down.
text.zh: 黄昏来得越来越早。我每周都要早一点点灯，我都记着。

text.en: Lina and Oskar home. Tonight the village gives thanks at the flame. You will come.
text.zh: 莉娜和奥斯卡回来了。今晚全村在火前感恩。你会来的。

text.en: Some people take a thing to keep it.
text.zh: 有些人拿走一样东西，是为了守住它。

text.en: I sweep the altar every morning. Habit. It is cold under my hand.
text.zh: 我每天早上都扫一遍祭坛。习惯了。它在我手底下是凉的。

text.en: Astra bore five sufferings so the sun would rise. The Seal-bearers carry them still. Go to the first of them, pilgrim.
text.zh: 阿斯特拉承受了五苦，太阳才重新升起。持印者至今仍背负着它们。去找第一位吧，朝圣者。

text.en: The Crown of Thorns, in our village. I never thought to see it. Keep it close to you, and far from your heart.
text.zh: 荆棘冠，竟然到了我们村里。我从没想过能亲眼见到它。把它贴身收好——但别让它靠近你的心。

text.en: He always did carry things that were too heavy for him.
text.zh: 他从小就总是背着对他来说太重的东西。

lines.en: An axe fells a tree, an axe on a log gives planks. Three planks and the footbridge is whole. That is the whole secret.
lines.zh: 斧头砍树，斧头劈木头出木板。三块木板，小桥就完整了。秘诀就这么多。

lines.en: Nails pulled straight and laid in a row. No storm pulls nails. Someone wanted that bridge gone, and wanted us to know it.
lines.zh: 钉子拔得笔直，摆成一排。哪场风暴会拔钉子？有人就是想让那座桥没了，还想让我们知道。

text.en: Joss. I build things that stay built. Mostly.
text.zh: 乔斯。我造的东西都结实。大部分是。

text.en: An axe fells a tree, an axe on a log gives planks. Three planks and the footbridge is whole. That is the whole secret.
text.zh: 斧头砍树，斧头劈木头出木板。三块木板，小桥就完整了。秘诀就这么多。

text.en: Nails pulled straight and laid in a row. No storm pulls nails. Someone wanted that bridge gone, and wanted us to know it.
text.zh: 钉子拔得笔直，摆成一排。哪场风暴会拔钉子？有人就是想让那座桥没了，还想让我们知道。

text.en: You crossed. Good. Aldo would have laughed to see it — he said that bridge would outlive us both.
text.zh: 你过去了。好。阿尔多要是看见了准会笑——他说过那座桥会比我们俩都活得长。

text.en: A grey young man paid for that bridge, twenty years back. Old coin, no king on it. "A road out of here a cart could take in a hurry," he said. I never knew what he meant.
text.zh: 二十年前，是个穿灰衣服的年轻人出钱造的那座桥。旧钱币，上面没有国王的头像。他说："要一条能让马车赶紧离开这里的路。"我一直不明白他是什么意思。

lines.en: I saw the grey man. Three times! Nobody believes me. He gave me a stone that is warm at night.
lines.zh: 我见过那个灰衣人。三次！没人信我。他给了我一块晚上会发热的石头。

lines.en: Since I got the stone, the night things don't come near my window. Auntie says that's nonsense.
lines.zh: 自从有了那块石头，夜里的东西就不靠近我的窗户了。姑姑说那是瞎说。

text.en: Are you a knight? You have a fairy! Can I draw her?
text.zh: 你是骑士吗？你有个精灵！我能画她吗？

text.en: I saw the grey man. Three times! Nobody believes me. He gave me a stone that is warm at night.
text.zh: 我见过那个灰衣人。三次！没人信我。他给了我一块晚上会发热的石头。

text.en: Since I got the stone, the night things don't come near my window. Auntie says that's nonsense.
text.zh: 自从有了那块石头，夜里的东西就不靠近我的窗户了。姑姑说那是瞎说。

text.en: I TOLD them. I told them about the grey man. Now everyone believes me and nobody is happy about it.
text.zh: 我早就说了。我早就跟他们说过灰衣人。现在大家都信了，可谁都不高兴。

text.en: Was he bad? The grey man? He didn't look bad. He looked tired.
text.zh: 他是坏人吗？那个灰衣人？他看起来不像坏人。他看起来很累。

entries.activity: draw on the walls in chalk

lines.en: Every month the sun sets earlier. Four minutes, five, six. I write it all down. The numbers make a curve, and I do not like where it goes.
lines.zh: 太阳每个月都落得更早。四分钟、五分钟、六分钟。我全都记下来了。这些数字连成一条曲线，我不喜欢它的去向。

lines.en: Tobin sold me an almanac from before the First Night. Its curve matches mine. Exactly.
lines.zh: 托宾卖给我一本初夜之前的旧历书。它的曲线和我的一模一样。分毫不差。

text.en: Nessa Quill, almanacs for the Holy City. Stranded since the bridge went. Do you know what time it is? Exactly?
text.zh: 奈莎·奎尔，给圣城编历书的。桥断了以后就困在这里。你知道现在几点吗？精确地？

text.en: Every month the sun sets earlier. Four minutes, five, six. I write it all down. The numbers make a curve, and I do not like where it goes.
text.zh: 太阳每个月都落得更早。四分钟、五分钟、六分钟。我全都记下来了。这些数字连成一条曲线，我不喜欢它的去向。

text.en: Tobin sold me an almanac from before the First Night. Its curve matches mine. Exactly.
text.zh: 托宾卖给我一本初夜之前的旧历书。它的曲线和我的一模一样。分毫不差。

text.en: Hush — the sun is touching the trees. Fourteen. Fifteen. There.
text.zh: 嘘——太阳碰到树梢了。十四。十五。好了。

text.en: Four minutes. The sun set four minutes early tonight. On the day the first seal fell. I am sure it means nothing.
text.zh: 四分钟。今晚太阳早落了四分钟。偏偏是第一道印倒下的那天。我相信这什么都不代表。

lines.en: I carried a lance for the Seal-bearers once. Long time ago. Long enough.
lines.zh: 我曾经为持印者扛过长枪。很久以前了。久到够了。

text.en: Sit if you like. Don't ask about the armour.
text.zh: 想坐就坐。别问盔甲的事。

text.en: I carried a lance for the Seal-bearers once. Long time ago. Long enough.
text.zh: 我曾经为持印者扛过长枪。很久以前了。久到够了。

text.en: The White Knight. Alberic. He used to kneel to children. Now he makes the world kneel to him. That is what the crown does.
text.zh: 白骑士。阿尔贝里克。他以前会对孩子单膝下跪。现在他要整个世界向他下跪。那顶冠冕就是这样改变人的。

text.en: A grey cloak, ash on his hands? ...No. I knew a man like that. He would not. Unless he had a reason, and that scares me more.
text.zh: 灰斗篷，手上有灰？……不。我认识一个那样的人。他不会的。除非他有理由——那就更让我害怕了。

text.en: You saw the carving at the barrow mouth? The Order of the Thorn buried its own there, before my time. The warden was one of us. Alberic's brothers, all of them, and none of them lying still.
text.zh: 你看到古墓门口的刻纹了？荆棘骑士团在那里埋葬自己的人，比我入团还早。那个守墓者是我们的人。全都是阿尔贝里克的兄弟，一个都没能安息。

text.en: You brought him down. Did he — was he himself, at the end? ...Good. Good.
text.zh: 你打倒了他。他……最后，他还是他自己吗？……那就好。那就好。

lines.en: The days got too short for the wheat. Then the night things came for what was left. The house is all I kept.
lines.zh: 白天短得麦子都长不成。后来夜里的东西把剩下的也夺走了。我只保住了这栋房子。

lines.en: There's a knight up the road, in white. He took my husband's ring off the gatepost. Took everything that shone.
lines.zh: 路那头有个白衣骑士。他从门柱上取走了我丈夫的戒指。凡是会发光的东西他都拿走了。

text.en: Stay back! ...You're not one of them. Sorry. I don't see many living faces out here any more.
text.zh: 别过来！……你不是那些东西。抱歉。这一带我很久没见过活人的脸了。

text.en: The days got too short for the wheat. Then the night things came for what was left. The house is all I kept.
text.zh: 白天短得麦子都长不成。后来夜里的东西把剩下的也夺走了。我只保住了这栋房子。

text.en: There's a knight up the road, in white. He took my husband's ring off the gatepost. Took everything that shone.
text.zh: 路那头有个白衣骑士。他从门柱上取走了我丈夫的戒指。凡是会发光的东西他都拿走了。

text.en: A grey man came through, the night of the fire. He pulled me out of the smoke. Don't tell anyone in the village I said so.
text.zh: 着火那天夜里，有个灰衣人路过。是他把我从烟里拉出来的。别跟村里人说是我讲的。

text.en: The road is quiet again. I'll go to Firstlight — there's nothing to keep me here but ash.
text.zh: 路上又安静了。我去初原村——这里除了灰烬，什么都留不住我了。

lines.en: Every dusk they go down on their knees, the whole herd, all facing east. My gran never saw a cow kneel in her life.
lines.zh: 每到黄昏，整群牛都会跪下来，全都朝着东边。我奶奶活了一辈子都没见过牛下跪。

lines.en: The grass is thin this year. Short days, short grass. That's all it is. That's what I tell them.
lines.zh: 今年的草很稀。白天短，草也短。就这么回事。我是这么跟它们说的。

text.en: Mind the hens. And don't run — the cows spook. Brin. I keep the herd.
text.zh: 小心鸡。也别跑——牛会受惊的。我叫布琳，管牛群的。

text.en: Every dusk they go down on their knees, the whole herd, all facing east. My gran never saw a cow kneel in her life.
text.zh: 每到黄昏，整群牛都会跪下来，全都朝着东边。我奶奶活了一辈子都没见过牛下跪。

text.en: The grass is thin this year. Short days, short grass. That's all it is. That's what I tell them.
text.zh: 今年的草很稀。白天短，草也短。就这么回事。我是这么跟它们说的。

text.en: Here it comes — watch them. ...There. Down they go. East.
text.zh: 来了——你看它们。……看。跪下了。朝东。

text.en: They stopped kneeling. The day you came back with that crown, they stopped. ...They just stand there now and look east.
text.zh: 它们不跪了。你带着那顶冠回来的那天，就不跪了。……现在它们只是站着，朝东看。

lines.en: The wheel turns slower every week. The brook comes off the hills, and the hills get less sun. That is all it is.
lines.zh: 水车一周比一周转得慢。溪水是从山上下来的，山上晒的太阳越来越少。就这么回事。

lines.en: Something got into the cellar after dark. Slimes, and worse. The vigil oil is down there. I am not going down.
lines.zh: 天黑以后有东西钻进了地窖。史莱姆，还有更糟的。守夜用的灯油就在下面。我可不下去。

text.en: Tam. I grind for Firstlight and press its lamp oil. Mind the brook, it bites in the cold.
text.zh: 我叫塔姆。给初原村磨面、榨灯油。小心那条溪，天冷的时候它咬人。

text.en: The wheel turns slower every week. The brook comes off the hills, and the hills get less sun. That is all it is.
text.zh: 水车一周比一周转得慢。溪水是从山上下来的，山上晒的太阳越来越少。就这么回事。

text.en: Something got into the cellar after dark. Slimes, and worse. The vigil oil is down there. I am not going down.
text.zh: 天黑以后有东西钻进了地窖。史莱姆，还有更糟的。守夜用的灯油就在下面。我可不下去。

text.en: You brought the oil up? The lamps will burn tonight, then. My grandmother said the vigil lamps were lit from the first dawn. I believe her more than I used to.
text.zh: 你把油拿上来了？那今晚的灯能点起来了。我奶奶说守夜灯是用最初的晨光点着的。比起从前，我现在更信她的话了。

lines.en: I will hold until I am relieved. You relieved me — so now I hold for you. It is the same vow, turned round.
lines.zh: 我将坚守，直到有人来接替我。你接替了我——所以现在我为你坚守。还是同一个誓言，只是转了个方向。

lines.en: Plant what you like. Build what you like. Nothing here needs to kneel.
lines.zh: 想种什么就种什么。想建什么就建什么。这里没有什么需要下跪。

lines.en: The mist is only the edge of what I can hold. Bring me what a wider ground needs, and I will push it back.
lines.zh: 迷雾只是我能守住的边界。把扩建所需的东西带给我，我就把它推远一些。

text.en: You came back. Good. The ground is quiet while you are away; I keep it so.
text.zh: 你回来了。很好。你不在的时候，这片土地很安静；我让它保持安静。

text.en: I will hold until I am relieved. You relieved me — so now I hold for you. It is the same vow, turned round.
text.zh: 我将坚守，直到有人来接替我。你接替了我——所以现在我为你坚守。还是同一个誓言，只是转了个方向。

text.en: Plant what you like. Build what you like. Nothing here needs to kneel.
text.zh: 想种什么就种什么。想建什么就建什么。这里没有什么需要下跪。

text.en: The mist is only the edge of what I can hold. Bring me what a wider ground needs, and I will push it back.
text.zh: 迷雾只是我能守住的边界。把扩建所需的东西带给我，我就把它推远一些。

text.en: The sun goes down early. Earlier than it used to. I am sorry for that. I think I am.
text.zh: 太阳落得早。比从前早。我很抱歉。我想我是抱歉的。

text.en: There was a squire, once. He carried my lance. I cannot see his face any more. If you meet him — tell him I am sorry I asked his name.
text.zh: 从前有个侍从。他给我扛长枪。我已经想不起他的脸了。如果你遇见他——告诉他，我很抱歉问了他的名字。

lines.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment.
lines.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。

text.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment.
text.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。

name.en: The White Knight Alberic · First Seal
name.zh: 白骑士·阿尔贝里克 · 第一印

name.en: The Crown Without a King · Pride

summary.en: Lina and Oskar sheltered from the storm in the Old Barrow, south past the grassland, the forest and Thornwood Hollow, and the dead shut them in. The barrow goes down three floors. Find them both, put down the warden in the deepest, and come back to Rowan.
summary.zh: 莉娜和奥斯卡为了躲风暴进了古墓（往南过了草原、森林和荆棘谷），被亡灵困在里面。古墓往下有三层。找到他们两个，打倒最深处的守墓者，再回来找罗万。

offer.en: You came down the mountain? Then you can fight. Two of ours, Lina and Oskar, went into the old barrow past the hollow when the storm broke. The dead keep it. Bring them home.
offer.zh: 你是从山上下来的？那你能打。我们有两个人——莉娜和奥斯卡——风暴来时躲进了荆棘谷那头的古墓。那里有亡灵把守。把他们带回家吧。

waiting.en: South, past the grassland and the forest, through the hollow. The barrow mouth is between two standing stones.
waiting.zh: 往南，过了草原和森林，穿过荆棘谷。古墓入口在两块立石中间。

done.en: Both home, and the warden down. Firstlight owes you. Tonight, after dark, the whole village gives thanks at the flame — stay for it.
done.zh: 两个人都回来了，守卫也倒了。初原村欠你一份情。今晚天黑以后，全村会在圣火前感恩——留下来吧。

label.en: Through the grassland and the forest to the barrow mouth in Thornwood Hollow
label.zh: 穿过草原和森林，到荆棘谷的古墓入口

line.en: You came! The way out is clear? Then I am going home — tell Rowan I am all right.
line.zh: 你来了！出去的路通了？那我回家了——跟罗万说我没事。

line.en: About time. I will follow the girl home. The warden keeps the bottom of the stair — if it still walks, mind it.
line.zh: 可算来了。我跟着那丫头回家。守墓者在下面——楼梯最底下。它要是还在，你小心点。

label.en: Find Oskar in the ossuary, the second floor
label.zh: 在第二层骸骨堂找到奥斯卡

label.en: Put down the warden in the sanctum, the deepest floor
label.zh: 在最深处的圣所打倒守墓者

summary.en: Marta needs 3 raw beef and 2 eggs for the village stew. The cows and hens graze the grassland south of the village.
summary.zh: 玛尔塔需要 3 块生牛肉和 2 个鸡蛋来炖全村的菜。牛和鸡在村子南边的草原上。

offer.en: Three cuts of beef and two eggs, and the whole village eats tonight. The herd is on the grassland, south.
offer.zh: 三块牛肉、两个鸡蛋，今晚全村就都有饭吃了。牛群在南边的草原上。

waiting.en: Three beef, two eggs. The pot is waiting.
waiting.zh: 三块牛肉，两个鸡蛋。锅还等着呢。

done.en: Now that is a stew. Here — the first bowl is yours, and take some bread for the road.
done.zh: 这才叫炖菜。来——第一碗给你，再带上点面包路上吃。

summary.en: Mia lost her grandmother's silver ring in the thorns of Thornwood Hollow. Find it and bring it back to her.
summary.zh: 米娅把奶奶的银戒指丢在了荆棘谷的荆棘丛里。找到它，带回来给她。

offer.en: Promise you won't tell Mum? I went to the hollow — just to look — and Gran's ring fell in the thorns on the east side. Could you find it?
offer.zh: 你保证不告诉妈妈？我去了荆棘谷——就看了一眼——奶奶的戒指掉进东边的荆棘丛里了。你能帮我找回来吗？

waiting.en: East side of the hollow, where the thorns are thickest. It is silver.
waiting.zh: 荆棘谷东边，荆棘最密的地方。是银的。

done.en: You found it! Gran's ring! Here, this is my best stone. It's lucky. Mostly.
done.zh: 你找到了！奶奶的戒指！给，这是我最好的石头，会带来好运的。大概吧。

summary.en: Holt wants the trail through Thornwood Hollow safe: fell 6 creatures there.
summary.zh: 霍尔特想让穿过荆棘谷的小路安全些：在那里打倒 6 只怪物。

offer.en: The things in the hollow are getting bold — they come up as far as the grassland now. Thin them out. Six should teach them.
offer.zh: 荆棘谷里的东西越来越大胆了——现在都跑到草原上来了。去清一清。打掉六只，应该能让它们长点记性。

waiting.en: Six. Slimes, spiders, wolves, whatever moves in the hollow.
waiting.zh: 六只。史莱姆、蜘蛛、狼，荆棘谷里会动的都算。

done.en: Quieter already. Take this — a guard with a spare arm is a guard who listens.
done.zh: 已经安静多了。拿着这个——有备用武器的卫兵才听得进话。

summary.en: Gus needs 4 logs a day for the village fire. Fell a tree with an axe (two swings). Comes round again each day.
summary.zh: 格斯每天需要 4 根木头给村里的火堆。用斧头砍树（砍两下）。每天都能再接。

offer.en: Four logs, and my back thanks you. The fire wants them every day, mind.
offer.zh: 四根木头，我的腰会感谢你的。不过这火天天都要喂。

waiting.en: Four logs. Any tree will do.

done.en: That will see us through the night. Same again tomorrow?
done.zh: 这够撑过今晚了。明天还来吗？

summary.en: You woke on Cloudtop with a fairy at your side. Go down: past the old shrine stone at the Mountain Foot, down the cliff stair to the Ford, and west to the village there.
summary.zh: 你在云顶台地醒来，身边多了一个精灵。下山吧：经过山脚的古老路碑，顺着悬崖台阶下到渡口，再往西去那里的村子。

label.en: The shrine stone at the Mountain Foot
Down the cliff stair to the Ford
label.zh: 顺着悬崖台阶下到渡口

summary.en: Firstlight keeps a vigil at its flame for those who come home. Sister Ilse needs lamp oil from the cellar at Millbrook, west of the village; dawnbloom from Dawn Hill, north of it; and the old bell rung in the Chapel of the First Dawn on the hill's top. Beyond the vigil, the road east and the White Knight wait.
summary.zh: 初原村会为归来的人在圣火前守夜。伊尔丝修女需要：村子西边水车磨坊地窖里的灯油；村子北边晨光丘上的晨光花；还有在丘顶初晓礼拜堂里敲响那口旧钟。守夜之后，东边的大路和白骑士在等着你。

waiting.en: Oil from Tam's cellar, dawnbloom from the hill, and the bell. The bell was rung the morning the sun came back. It should be rung for this.
waiting.zh: 塔姆地窖里的油，丘上的晨光花，还有那口钟。太阳回来的那天早上，有人敲响过它。今晚也该敲响它。

done.en: The lamps are trimmed and the bell has rung. Tonight, after dark, Firstlight gives thanks. Stay for it.
done.zh: 灯已经备好，钟也敲响了。今晚天黑以后，初原村要感恩。留下来吧。

label.en: Vigil oil from the mill cellar (Millbrook, west)
label.zh: 磨坊地窖里的守夜灯油（往西，水车磨坊）
晨光丘上的晨光花（往北）

label.en: Ring the bell in the Chapel of the First Dawn
label.zh: 在初晓礼拜堂敲响那口钟

summary.en: The days grow shorter. Beyond the Ford, on the road east, the White Knight Alberic — the First Seal-bearer — holds the land as his kingdom, and nothing crosses that does not kneel. Firstlight gives thanks tonight; then the road, the river, and the knight.
summary.zh: 白昼越来越短。渡口那边的东大路上，第一位持印者——白骑士阿尔贝里克——把那片土地当成了他的王国，不跪者不得过。今晚初原村要感恩；然后是大路、河流，和那位骑士。

label.en: The night of thanks at the flame (Firstlight, after dark)
label.zh: 圣火前的感恩之夜（入夜后在初原村）

label.en: The Church's letter (Firstlight, the morning after)
label.zh: 教会的来信（第二天早上，初原村）

label.en: Across the river at the Ford
Bring down the White Knight Alberic on the East Road
label.zh: 在东大路打倒白骑士阿尔贝里克

summary.en: The First Seal has fallen and the Crown of Thorns is yours. Carry it home to Firstlight.
summary.zh: 第一印已经倒下，荆棘冠在你手里。把它带回初原村。

label.en: Bring the Crown home to Firstlight

summary.en: The Seal-bearers fail and the Long Night returns. The first of them, the White Knight Alberic, holds the road east beyond the Ford. Before you go: hear Fennick on the knight, ask Joss about the bridge, and Hesper what she saw.
summary.zh: 持印者正在衰败，极夜正在回来。第一位持印者白骑士阿尔贝里克，守在渡口以东的大路上。出发之前：听芬尼克讲讲那位骑士，问问乔斯桥的事，再问问赫斯珀她看到了什么。

offer.en: Astra bore five sufferings so that the sun would rise. Five Seal-bearers carry them still, and they are failing. The first holds the road beyond our ford. Talk to those who know the way — Fennick, Joss, Hesper — then go.
offer.zh: 阿斯特拉承受了五苦，太阳才得以升起。五位持印者至今背负着它们，而他们正在衰败。第一位就守在我们渡口那边的路上。去问问认得路的人——芬尼克、乔斯、赫斯珀——然后出发吧。

waiting.en: Fennick by the bench, Joss at his workbench, Hesper at the Ford. They each know a piece of the road.
waiting.zh: 芬尼克在长凳边，乔斯在工作台旁，赫斯珀在渡口。他们每人都知道这条路的一段。

done.en: Then go with the blessing of the Five. Suffering is not God's abandonment — remember that, out there.
done.zh: 那就带着五苦的祝福去吧。苦难并非神的遗弃——到了外面，记住这句话。

line.en: Alberic? When he plants his sword, the thorns come up in a ring around him. Inside the ring, or well outside it — never on it. And when he draws his bow, do not stand in front of him.
line.zh: 阿尔贝里克？他把剑插进地里的时候，荆棘会在他周围长成一圈。站在圈里，或者离得远远的——就是别站在圈上。他拉弓的时候，别站在他正前方。

line.en: Three planks fill the gap. An axe fells a tree and splits a log; lay the planks on the water. Or go round some other way — the river does not care how.
line.zh: 三块木板就能补上缺口。斧头砍树、劈木头；把木板铺到水面上。或者想别的办法过去——河才不在乎你怎么过。

line.en: White, all of him. A crown of thorns grown through his helm. He pulled my bridge out board by board and laid the nails on the pier like a toll paid. He did not look at me once.
line.zh: 他浑身是白的。荆棘冠长进了他的头盔里。他一块一块把我的桥拆了，把钉子摆在码头上，像是在收过路费。他一眼都没看我。

label.zh: 问赫斯珀她看到了什么

summary.en: Pell draws the grey man wherever he has seen him: by the shrine stone at the Mountain Foot, at the barrow door, by the footbridge, and here by the flame. Find all four drawings (E reads one).
summary.zh: 佩尔在每个见过灰衣人的地方都画了画：山脚的路碑旁、古墓门口、小桥边，还有村里的圣火旁。找到全部四幅画（按 E 查看）。

offer.en: Nobody believes me. So I drew him everywhere I saw him. Four places! If you find them all, you'll see. Then you'll believe me.
offer.zh: 没人信我。所以我在每个见过他的地方都画了下来。四个地方！你要是都找到了，就明白了。然后你就会信我了。

waiting.en: The shrine stone up the mountain, the barrow door, the little bridge, and here by the fire. I draw small, look down.
waiting.zh: 山上的路碑、古墓的门、小桥，还有这边火堆旁。我画得小，要往地上看。

done.en: You saw? He was there every time — the night before something bad. He wasn't doing the bad thing. He was there first. Here, you can have my other warm stone.
done.zh: 你看到了吧？每次他都在——都是坏事发生的前一天晚上。坏事不是他干的。他只是先到了。给，我另一块暖石头给你。

summary.en: Nessa needs readings of the sky from the waypoint statues. Wake three of them (E on each): the Mountain Foot's, the village's, the Ford's, or the one on the East Road.
summary.zh: 奈莎需要在传送雕像上读取天象数据。唤醒其中三座（对每座按 E）：山脚的、村里的、渡口的，或者东大路上的那座。

offer.en: The statues are older than the Church. They hum at the hour of sunset — if I can read three of them, I can tell how fast the days are going. Wake three for me?
offer.zh: 那些雕像比教会还古老。日落时分它们会嗡嗡作响——只要能读到三座，我就能算出白天缩短得有多快。帮我唤醒三座？

waiting.en: Three statues. The one at the Mountain Foot, ours by the square, the Ford's... they are all humming the same note, lower every week.
waiting.zh: 三座雕像。山脚那座、我们广场边这座、渡口那座……它们哼的都是同一个音，一周比一周低。

done.en: Lower every week, and faster than the old almanac says. Take it — I have copied what I need. Read the last pages. I cannot make sense of them.
done.zh: 一周比一周低，而且比旧历书说的还快。拿去吧——我需要的都抄下来了。读读最后几页。我怎么也看不懂。

summary.en: Fennick will not send anyone against a Seal-bearer who has not stood a night in the wild. Put down 3 of the dead that walk after dark (outside the village).
summary.zh: 芬尼克不会让没在荒野里熬过一夜的人去挑战持印者。在天黑后打倒 3 个游荡的亡灵（村子外面）。

offer.en: You want to face a Seal-bearer? Then face the night first. The dead walk the grassland after dark. Put three of them down and come back with your legs still under you.
offer.zh: 你想去挑战持印者？那就先挑战夜晚。天黑以后草原上有亡灵游荡。打倒三个，然后自己走回来。

waiting.en: Three of the dead. They come out after dark, out past the fence. Keep moving.
waiting.zh: 三个亡灵。天黑以后出来，在围栏外面。别停下脚步。

done.en: Still standing. Good. Take my old helm — it stopped worse than claws, once.
done.zh: 还站着。好。拿上我的旧头盔——它以前挡过比爪子更狠的东西。

summary.en: Nine nails held the bridge's three boards; eight lay on the pier. Joss wants the ninth back. It went with whoever took the bridge — east.
summary.zh: 小桥三块木板一共用了九根钉子；码头上只摆着八根。乔斯想把第九根找回来。它跟着拆桥的人去了——东边。

offer.en: Eight nails on the pier. Eight. I drove nine. Whoever took my bridge kept one — find it for me, if you go that way.
offer.zh: 码头上八根钉子。八根。我钉了九根。拆我桥的人留了一根——你要是往那边去，帮我找回来。

waiting.en: The ninth nail. Square-headed, pulled straight. You'll know it.
waiting.zh: 第九根钉子。方头的，拔得笔直。你一看就知道。

done.en: The ninth. ...Twenty years that bridge stood. Here — a proper hammer. You've earned it.
done.zh: 第九根。……那座桥立了二十年。给——一把像样的锤子。这是你应得的。

summary.en: The Church kept a watch on Cloudtop, at the top of the mountain, to time the sunset. Nessa wants to know what its log says. Find the logbook in the ruined shelter there and read it (E).
summary.zh: 教会曾在山顶的云顶台地设过观日哨，专门记录日落时间。奈莎想知道哨所的日志里写了什么。到那里的破旧小屋找到日志，读一读（按 E）。

offer.en: There was a Church watch on Cloudtop — one man, timing every sunset for the almanacs. His reports stopped coming years ago. If his log is still up there, I need to know what it says.
offer.zh: 云顶台地以前有个教会的观日哨——就一个人，给历书记下每一次日落。他的报告好几年前就断了。要是他的日志还在山上，我得知道上面写了什么。

waiting.en: Cloudtop, above the Mountain Foot. A shelter on the snow. He kept his log on the table, if I know watchmen.
waiting.zh: 云顶台地，在山脚上面。雪地上有间小屋。要是我没猜错，守夜人会把日志放在桌上。

done.en: Eleven years. The sunsets were coming early ELEVEN years ago, and he wrote it down every night, and nobody read it. ...And a sleeping light in the snow? Pip, you do not remember a watchman, do you? No. Of course not.
done.zh: 十一年。十一年前日落就开始提前了，他每天晚上都记下来，却没有人读过。……还有雪里一点睡着的光？小啾，你不记得什么守夜人吧？不记得。当然不记得。

label.en: Read the watchman's log on Cloudtop
label.zh: 读云顶台地上守夜人的日志

summary.en: Brin's herd will not settle: the night-born come up out of the dark onto the grassland, more every week. Put down 3 of the dead that walk there after nightfall.
summary.zh: 布琳的牛群一直不安：夜里的东西从黑暗里爬上草原，一周比一周多。入夜后在草原上打倒 3 个游荡的亡灵。

offer.en: Three cows gone this month. Not wolves — wolves leave something. The dead walk the grass after dark now, and the herd knows it. Stand a night out here with me?
offer.zh: 这个月丢了三头牛。不是狼——狼总会留下点什么。现在天一黑，死人就在草地上走，牛群都知道。陪我在这儿守一夜？

waiting.en: They come up after dark, from the south end, by the trees. Three of them down and the herd will sleep.
waiting.zh: 它们天黑以后从南边树林那头上来。打倒三个，牛群就能睡了。

done.en: They're lying down. Lying down properly, not kneeling. ...Here, cheese from the last of the good milk. Thank you.
done.zh: 它们躺下了。是好好躺下，不是跪着。……给，用最后一点好奶做的奶酪。谢谢你。

label.en: The dead put down on the grassland

summary.en: A pilgrim camped deep in the forest long ago and never came back. Bring his scallop shell to Sister Ilse.
summary.zh: 很久以前，有个朝圣者在森林深处扎过营，再也没有回来。把他的扇贝徽记带给伊尔丝修女。

offer.en: A camp in the forest, with the Church's proclamation nailed up beside it? ...Bring me what he left. If he wore the scallop, bring that.
offer.zh: 森林里的营地，旁边还钉着教会的朝圣令？……把他留下的东西带给我。要是他戴着扇贝徽记，就把那个带来。

waiting.en: The scallop is the pilgrim's mark. Every one of us is given one when we are named.
waiting.zh: 扇贝是朝圣者的标记。每一个被点名的人都会得到一枚。

done.en: Brother Cassian. He sat in this chapel when I was a novice and asked me to pray for him. The Church named him pilgrim thirty-one years ago. ...They told us he reached the Holy City. Keep it. He would want it walking.
done.zh: 卡西安修士。我还是见习修女的时候，他坐在这间礼拜堂里，请我为他祈祷。三十一年前，教会点名他为朝圣者。……他们告诉我们，他到达了圣城。你留着吧。他会希望它继续上路。

summary.en: The White Knight took Edda's late husband's wedding band off her gatepost, with everything else that shone. It is somewhere in his kingdom up the road.
summary.zh: 白骑士把艾达亡夫的婚戒从她家门柱上拿走了，连同所有会发光的东西。它就在大路那头他的王国里。

offer.en: If you're going up the road — my husband's ring. The knight took it with everything else. I don't care about the rest.
offer.zh: 你要是往那条路上去——我丈夫的戒指。骑士把它和别的东西一起拿走了。别的我都不在乎。

waiting.en: A plain band. It's all I have of him.
waiting.zh: 一枚普通的戒指。这是他留给我的全部。

done.en: ...Thank you. I'll wear it now. I was keeping it on the gate so he could find his way home.
done.zh: ……谢谢你。我现在就戴上。之前我把它挂在门上，是想让他能找到回家的路。

summary.en: Alberic, steward of the Held Ground, can push the mist back further — with what it takes to hold more ground.
summary.zh: 誓守之地的管家阿尔贝里克可以把迷雾再推远一些——只要有守住更多土地所需的东西。

offer.en: The ground holds as far as I can hold it. Bring me ten logs and ten stones, and I will set a fence of them in the mist — and the mist will keep behind it.
offer.zh: 这片土地，我能守多远就有多远。给我十根原木、十块石头，我把它们在迷雾里立成一道篱笆——迷雾就会退到篱笆后面。

waiting.en: Bring what I asked, and I will hold more ground for you.
waiting.zh: 把我要的东西带来，我就为你守住更多的土地。

done.en: There. Do you see how far it goes now? A knight is only as wide as what he holds.
done.zh: 好了。看见它现在延伸到多远了吗？一个骑士的分量，就是他守住的那片土地。

summary.en: Alberic, steward of the Held Ground, can push the mist back further — with what it takes to hold more ground.
summary.zh: 誓守之地的管家阿尔贝里克可以把迷雾再推远一些——只要有守住更多土地所需的东西。

offer.en: Twenty planks and five iron ore. Iron for the posts, planks for the walls — a hall needs room round it.
offer.zh: 二十块木板、五块铁矿石。铁做桩，木板做墙——一座厅堂周围要留出地方。

waiting.en: Bring what I asked, and I will hold more ground for you.
waiting.zh: 把我要的东西带来，我就为你守住更多的土地。

done.en: More ground. I remember fields like this, once. Whose they were, I do not.
done.zh: 又多了一片地。我记得从前也有过这样的田野。是谁的，我想不起来了。

summary.en: Alberic, steward of the Held Ground, can push the mist back further — with what it takes to hold more ground.
summary.zh: 誓守之地的管家阿尔贝里克可以把迷雾再推远一些——只要有守住更多土地所需的东西。

offer.en: The last of it: thirty planks, thirty stones, three gold. Gold for the boundary stones — they are what a kingdom is.
offer.zh: 最后一次了：三十块木板、三十块石头、三块金矿石。金子用来做界石——一个王国就是由界石圈出来的。

waiting.en: Bring what I asked, and I will hold more ground for you.
waiting.zh: 把我要的东西带来，我就为你守住更多的土地。

done.en: That is all the ground there is. ...It is more than I held before. And nobody kneels here.
done.zh: 这就是全部的土地了。……比我从前守的还要多。而且在这里，没有人下跪。

hint.en: WASD moves you. F picks up what you point at; hold it (1–0) and right click to eat it.
hint.zh: WASD 移动。F 捡起鼠标指着的东西；用 1–0 拿在手上，右键吃掉。

say.en: Over here — WASD walks.
say.zh: 到这儿来——WASD 走路。

say.en: Berries! Stand by them and press F.
say.zh: 浆果！站到旁边按 F 捡起来。

say.en: Take them in hand: their number on the toolbar.
say.zh: 拿到手上：按快捷栏上它们那一格的数字。

say.en: A right click eats what you hold.
say.zh: 右键吃掉手里的东西。

hint.en: They lie about the clearing, and more turn up. F picks them up; I opens the bag.
hint.zh: 空地上到处都有，而且会不断长出来。F 捡起来；I 打开背包。

say.en: I opens your bag: everything you carry.
say.zh: 按 I 打开背包：身上的东西都在里面。

say.en: A stick — F.
say.zh: 一根树枝——按 F。

say.en: A stone.
say.zh: 一块石头。

say.en: And a tuft of grass.
say.zh: 再来一把草。

hint.en: C opens crafting: a stick, a stone and a tuft of grass.
hint.zh: C 打开制作：一根树枝、一块石头、一把草。

say.en: C opens crafting. Make the stone axe.
say.zh: 按 C 打开制作，做一把石斧。

title.en: Fell a tree and split planks

hint.en: Hold the axe and left click a tree: it falls into logs. Left click a log with the axe: planks.
hint.zh: 拿着斧头左键点树，树倒下变成原木；再用斧头左键点原木，劈成木板。

say.en: The axe in hand.
say.zh: 把斧头拿到手上。

say.en: A tree in the grove: left click, again and again.
say.zh: 东边林子里的树：左键，一下一下砍。

say.en: C: the logs into planks — the axe at hand does it.
say.zh: 按 C：把原木做成木板——身上有斧头就行。

title.en: Build a campfire and light it

hint.en: B opens building: a ring of stones and sticks is a campfire. C makes a torch (a stick and grass); left click the fire with it.
hint.zh: B 打开建造：石头和树枝围成营火。C 做一支火把（树枝加草），拿着它左键点营火。

say.en: B opens building: set a campfire down.
say.zh: 按 B 打开建造：放一堆营火。

say.en: C: a torch — a stick and grass.
say.zh: 按 C 做一支火把：树枝加草。

say.en: Torch in hand, left click the fire.
say.zh: 拿着火把，左键点营火。

title.en: Build a house with a bed

hint.en: C makes walls, a door, a floor and a bed from planks. Take one in hand and left click where it goes (hold and drag for a row; G sets it down too): walls and a door round you, the bed inside. The floor over your head is the ceiling, drawn a tile higher: a floor in hand, R, then left click just above your head (or in the build palette, B, R turns a floor into a ceiling).
hint.zh: C 用木板做墙、门、地板和床。拿在手上，左键点哪儿就放在哪儿（按住拖动放一排；G 也能放）：墙和门围住自己，床放在屋里。头顶那块是天花板，画在高一格的地方：手里拿着地板按 R，再左键点头顶上方一格（或在建造模式 B 里按 R 把地板切换成天花板）。

say.en: B: a wall — the first one on the outline.
say.zh: 按 B 选墙——第一面放在画好的轮廓上。

say.en: Walls round, and a door.
say.zh: 把墙围起来，再装一扇门。

say.en: A bed inside.
say.zh: 屋里放一张床。

say.en: Now a ceiling: in B choose the floor, and R makes it the ceiling.
say.zh: 最后是天花板：在 B 里选地板，按 R 切成天花板。

hint.en: Things walk in the dark. Sleep in your bed (E) — not on an empty stomach, or hunger wakes you in the night. At first light we go.
hint.zh: 天黑以后会有东西出来游荡。在床上睡一觉（E）——别空着肚子睡，不然会半夜饿醒。天一亮我们就出发。

say.en: Hold E on the bed: every layer of a cell, to choose from.
say.zh: 对着床长按 E：一格里的每一层都列出来，任你选。

say.en: A dummy by the house: left click until it topples.
say.zh: 屋旁有个假人：左键打，直到把它打倒。

say.en: Before dark, shut the door: E.
say.zh: 天黑前关上门：按 E。

say.en: Then sleep in your bed: E.
say.zh: 然后上床睡觉：按 E。

hint.en: The path out of the clearing runs south, down to the foot of the mountain.
hint.zh: 空地南边的小路通往山脚。

say.en: M: the world map — every place you have been.
say.zh: 按 M 打开世界地图：去过的地方都在上面。

title.en: Try something the world has never seen
title.zh: 做一件世界从没见过的事

hint.en: Use what you hold on the old seal stone, put something on it, strike it — anything. The world learns.
hint.zh: 拿着东西对古老的封印石用一用、放点东西上去、打它一下——什么都行。世界会学习。

hint.en: The trail runs south off the mountain. J: the Threadbook keeps what the world has learned.
hint.zh: 小路往南下山。J：织线簿记着世界学会的事。

hint.en: Firstlight Village is west of the Ford. Rowan, its elder, is looking for anyone who can fight: a yellow "!" over a head means someone has a task for you (E to take it on).
hint.zh: 初原村在渡口西边。村里的长老罗万在找能打的人：头顶有黄色"！"的人有任务给你（按 E 接受）。

hint.en: The White Knight tore three planks out of the footbridge by the marsh. An axe fells a tree (two swings) and splits a log into planks; G lays a plank on the water. Any other way across counts too: E handles things, F takes, G puts or hands over, left click uses what you hold, right click uses it on yourself.
hint.zh: 白骑士拆走了沼泽边小桥上的三块木板。斧头能砍倒树（砍两下），也能把木头劈成木板；G 把木板铺到水上。别的过河办法也算：E 空手摆弄，F 拿取，G 放下或交出，左键用手里的东西，右键对自己用。

hint.en: Follow the road east past the burned farm. The First Seal-bearer, the White Knight Alberic, holds it as his kingdom. Watch where his blows will land, and be elsewhere.
hint.zh: 沿着大路往东走，经过烧毁的农庄。第一位持印者——白骑士阿尔贝里克——把那条路当成了他的王国。看清他的攻击会落在哪里，然后躲开。

hint.en: Find Mara, the elder of Emberfall. She will know what burns the hills.
hint.zh: 找到余烬镇的长老玛拉。她会知道是什么在烧山。

hint.en: Garrick the smith will forge a blade for 5 iron ore and 3 coal — the old mine north of the village has the veins (a pickaxe breaks them; the richest lie past the cyclops). Wren the herbalist will brew a fireproof draught for 3 fireweed (Firstlight Village) and 3 frostcap (the forest). Hand them what they ask (G), then talk to them (E).
hint.zh: 铁匠加里克要 5 块铁矿石和 3 块煤来锻一把剑——镇北的旧矿坑里有矿脉（用镐敲开）。草药师雷恩要 3 株火焰草（初原村）和 3 朵霜盖菇（森林）来熬防火药剂。把东西交给他们（G），再和他们说话（E）。

hint.en: Climb the pass east of Emberfall to the dragon's lair. Drink the fireproof draught before you go in.
hint.zh: 翻过余烬镇东边的山道，去魔龙的巢穴。进去之前喝下防火药剂。

hint.en: Defeat the dragon. Space strikes; keep out of its line of fire, and mind its whelps.
hint.zh: 打倒魔龙。空格键攻击；别站在它喷火的直线上，小心它的幼龙。

hint.en: The dragon is dead. Emberfall can sleep. What you taught the world is in the Threadbook (J).
hint.zh: 魔龙死了，余烬镇可以安睡了。你教会这个世界的事都记在织线簿里（J）。

title.en: The vigil, and a night of thanks

hint.en: Lina and Oskar are home. Prepare the vigil for Sister Ilse — oil from Millbrook (west), dawnbloom and the chapel bell on Dawn Hill (north) — then be in the village after dark.
hint.zh: 莉娜和奥斯卡回家了。为伊尔丝修女备好守夜——西边水车磨坊的油，北边晨光丘的晨光花和礼拜堂的钟——然后入夜时待在村里。

hint.en: The Firstlight is gone. Wait for morning in the village: something is coming up the road.
hint.zh: 初火不见了。在村里等到天亮：有人正沿着大路赶来。

hint.en: The Holy City has called the pilgrimage. Sister Ilse, at the cold altar, will tell you where it begins (E).
hint.zh: 圣城发布了朝圣令。冷掉的祭坛边，伊尔丝修女会告诉你朝圣从哪里开始（E）。

hint.en: The First Seal has fallen. Carry the Crown of Thorns back to Firstlight.
hint.zh: 第一印已经倒下。把荆棘冠带回初原村。

title.zh: 第二章：通往余烬镇的路

hint.en: The knight's kingdom is open. Beyond it, the road runs east to Emberfall.
hint.zh: 骑士的王国敞开了。穿过它，大路一直往东通向余烬镇。

say.en: Hey! You are awake at last! I am Pip — a fairy, and from today I go where you go.
say.zh: 嘿！你终于醒啦！我是小啾，是个精灵，从今天起你去哪儿我就去哪儿。

say.en: Better! To make anything we need sticks, stones and grass.
say.zh: 好多了吧！要做东西，得先有树枝、石头和草。

say.en: That is an axe's worth!
say.zh: 这些够做一把斧头了！

say.en: An axe! Now wood.
say.zh: 斧头！该去砍木头了。

say.en: Planks! Night comes early in the woods, and things walk in the dark. A fire first.
say.zh: 木板！林子里天黑得早，天黑以后会有东西出来游荡。先生火。

say.en: Warm! Now a roof over your head.
say.zh: 暖和了！现在给自己盖个屋子。

say.en: A home of your own! Now we only have to get through the night. Have a bite before you sleep — the berries keep coming. At first light, we go.
say.zh: 有家了！现在只要熬过今晚。睡前吃点东西——浆果会一直长出来。天一亮，我们就出发。

say.en: Morning! You made it through. The path south is clear now — down to the foot of the mountain!
say.zh: 天亮了！你熬过来了。南边的小路通了——下山去吧！

say.en: Not that way yet — the woods are no place to be lost in. Let us get settled here first.
say.zh: 先别往那边走——在林子里迷路可不是闹着玩的。先在这儿安顿下来吧。

say.en: The foot of the mountain! See the old stone in the flowers down there?
say.zh: 到山脚了！看见下面花丛里那块古老的石头了吗？

say.en: You're awake! I'm Pip, a fairy — from today I go where you go. This is Cloudtop, the plateau at the top of the mountain. The only way down is the cut in the rocks to the south; below it lies the Mountain Foot, and further down, the Ford.
say.zh: 你醒啦！我是小啾，是个精灵，从今天起你去哪儿我就去哪儿。这里是云顶台地，山顶上的高台。下山只有南边岩壁上的那道豁口；下面是山脚，再往下就是渡口。

say.en: Look — a waypoint statue! Walk up and press E to wake it; then the map (M) can take you back to it from anywhere.
say.zh: 看——是传送雕像！走过去按 E 唤醒它，以后在地图（M）上就能从任何地方传送回来。

say.en: It's colder near it. Five marks, and the first one is cracked... I don't like it. I don't know why I don't like it. — Try anything on it: use what you hold, put something on it, strike it. Whatever you do, the world learns.
say.zh: 它旁边好冷。五道痕，第一道裂开了……我不喜欢它。我也不知道为什么不喜欢。——对它做点什么吧：用手里的东西、放点东西上去、打它一下。不管你做什么，世界都会学着回应。

say.en: Did you see? The world answers what it has never seen. What it learns is kept in the Threadbook — J. Now, down to the Ford!
say.zh: 看到了吗？世界会回应它从没见过的事。它学会的都记在织线簿里——按 J。走吧，下山去渡口！

say.en: The Ford! Someone down there looks like they need a hand.
say.zh: 渡口到了！那边的人好像需要帮忙。

say.en: Look, steam! That is a healing spring — sit in it and your wounds close. Come back here whenever you are hurt.
say.zh: 看，冒着热气！那是疗伤温泉——泡进去伤口就会慢慢愈合。受伤了就回来泡一泡吧。

say.en: We made it across! ...But the village still needs us, and nobody has told us what is down that road yet. Let's not go far.
say.zh: 我们过来了！……不过村里还需要我们，也还没人告诉我们那条路上有什么。先别走太远。

text.en: Someone off the mountain? Nobody has come down that stair since the storm — and the evenings come sooner every week.
text.zh: 有人从山上下来了？风暴以后就没人走过那道石阶——而且天黑得一周比一周早。

text.en: The storm took the ferry rope. The footbridge it did not take: a rider did. All in white, a crown of thorns grown through his helm. He pulled the planks out with his hands and laid the nails on my pier like a toll paid.
text.zh: 风暴扯断了渡绳。可那座小桥不是风暴冲走的：是一个骑手拆的。浑身雪白，荆棘冠长进了他的头盔。他用手把木板拔出来，把钉子摆在我的码头上，像是付了过路费。

text.en: Three planks would span the bridge. There is an old axe by the stump; the woods have trees.
text.zh: 三块木板就能把桥接上。树桩边有把旧斧头，林子里有的是树。

text.en: West of here is Firstlight Village. Tobin keeps his cart there now — a meal might buy you something useful.
text.zh: 西边是初原村。托宾现在把货车停在那里——拿顿饭说不定能换点有用的东西。

text.en: A small place. Good soil, a well, and a roof when the weather turns.
text.zh: 村子不大。有能种东西的地，有井，变天了也有屋檐能躲。

text.en: But they have it worse than us — two of theirs are lost, they say. Rowan, their elder, is asking anyone who can fight. The bridge will keep; go to them first.
text.zh: 不过风暴对他们的打击比我们还重——听说有两个人失踪了。他们的长老罗万在找能打的人。桥可以等，先去帮他们吧。

text.en: (Still in your pack: the end of a travel loaf.)
text.zh: （行囊里还剩半块路上吃的面包。）

text.en: There. Mind the step — and the road. Nobody has walked it since the storm.
text.zh: 到了。小心脚下——也小心那条路。风暴以后还没人走过。

text.en: Go on, then. The rider went east along the road, past the burned farm. If you find him — mind his bow.
text.zh: 那就走吧。那个骑手沿着大路往东去了，过了烧毁的农庄。要是你找到他——当心他的弓。

text.en: If you need supplies before the road, Firstlight Village is still just west of here.
text.zh: 上路前若还缺东西，初原村就在渡口西边。

text.en: A traveller off the mountain, and a fairy at their shoulder. Welcome to Firstlight. Warm your hands — the flame was lit from the first dawn after the First Night.
text.zh: 一位从山上下来的旅人，肩头还停着一个精灵。欢迎来到初原村。暖暖手吧——这团火取自初夜之后的第一道晨光。

text.en: A FAIRY! Can I draw her? Hold still. Does she bite?
text.zh: 是精灵！我能画她吗？别动。她咬人吗？

text.en: I do NOT bite. ...Mostly. Draw my good side.
text.zh: 我才不咬人。……大部分时候不咬。画我好看的那边。

text.en: Pell, let them breathe. — You came down at a bad time, traveller. Two of ours are missing. When you have warmed up, come and find me.
text.zh: 佩尔，让人家喘口气。——旅人，你来得不是时候。我们有两个人失踪了。暖和过来以后，来找我。

text.en: You came! Listen — it wasn't the dead that shut us in. A man in grey pulled the inner door to, from outside. Then he pushed bread under it.
text.zh: 你来了！听我说——把我们关在这里的不是那些死人。是一个灰衣人，从外面把里面那道门拉上了。然后他从门缝下塞进来一块面包。

text.en: It has a mark on it. Ash. Like a thumb pressed in.
text.zh: 面包上有个印子。是灰。像是用拇指按上去的。

text.en: Oskar went down the stair in the east cell to find another way out. He didn't come back. It goes deeper than the barrow — much deeper.
text.zh: 奥斯卡顺着东边那间牢房里的楼梯下去找别的出路，再也没回来。下面比古墓深得多——深得多。

text.en: The dead in here won't sleep. They try to lie down and they can't. Like a bed that's too cold.
text.zh: 这里的死人睡不着。它们想躺下，可是躺不下去。就像一张太冷的床。

text.en: (As the warden comes apart, its jaw moves. Something like a voice comes out of it.)
text.zh: （守墓者散架的时候，它的下颚动了动。发出了某种像是声音的东西。）

text.en: ("The night... is coming back. I could not... lie down.")
text.zh: （"夜……在回来。我……躺不下。"）

text.en: Did it just— the dead don't talk. Do they? Do they?
text.zh: 它刚才是不是——死人不会说话的。对吧？对吧？

text.en: (Behind where it stood, words cut into the altar: "I WILL HOLD UNTIL I AM RELIEVED. — ALBERIC." Under them, pressed into the soot, a thumbprint of ash.)
text.zh: （在它原先站着的地方后面，祭坛上刻着字："我将坚守，直到有人来接替我。——阿尔贝里克。"字下面的烟灰里，按着一个灰色的拇指印。）

text.en: Alberic. That's the White Knight Hesper talks about. He swore to hold... and nobody ever came to relieve him.
text.zh: 阿尔贝里克。就是赫斯珀说的那个白骑士。他发誓要坚守……却再也没有人来接替他。

text.en: Sister Ilse, tell the one about the sun going out. Please. The pilgrim hasn't heard it.
text.zh: 伊尔丝修女，讲那个太阳熄灭的故事吧。求你了。朝圣者还没听过呢。

text.en: Long ago the days grew short, and shorter, until the sun did not rise at all. Crops died. Beasts went wrong. The dead would not lie down. That was the First Night.
text.zh: 很久以前，白昼越来越短，再越来越短，直到太阳再也没有升起。庄稼死了。野兽变了样。死人不肯安息。那就是初夜。

text.en: Then Astra came. He took a crown of thorns. He was scourged at the pillar. He starved upon the scales. He was nailed to the holy wood.
text.zh: 后来阿斯特拉来了。他戴上了荆棘冠。他在刑柱上受了鞭刑。他在天平上忍受饥饿。他被钉在圣木上。

text.en: And when the spear went through his heart — the sun rose.
text.zh: 当圣枪刺穿他的心脏时——太阳升起了。

text.en: Pip? You're shaking.
text.zh: 小啾？你在发抖。

text.en: I'm not. It's cold. It's just cold.
text.zh: 我没有。是冷。只是冷而已。

text.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment, Pell. It is the proof the debt is being paid. Now — tonight we give thanks.
text.zh: 佩尔，苦难并非神的遗弃。苦难，是灾厄得以被偿还的证明。好了——今晚我们要感恩。

text.en: You saw him too? A grey man walked over my river on ice he made as he went. It was gone behind him before I could get my boots on.
text.zh: 你也看见他了？一个灰衣人从我的河上走了过去，脚下边走边结冰。我还没穿上靴子，他身后的冰就化了。

text.en: (Far off east, past the far bank, a small light bobs along the road, and goes out.)
text.zh: （远远的东边，越过对岸，一点小小的光沿着大路晃动，然后熄灭了。）

text.en: Thirty-one years on this water. Never seen it carry a man before.
text.zh: 我在这条河上待了三十一年。从没见过它驮着一个人走。

text.en: I carried his lance for six years. He used to stop the whole column to kneel down and talk to children. Knights don't do that. He did.
text.zh: 我给他扛了六年长枪。他会让整支队伍停下来，就为了单膝跪下和孩子们说话。骑士是不会那样做的。他会。

text.en: Then they gave him the crown. A little more of him went every year. One morning he looked at me and asked my name.
text.zh: 后来他们把那顶冠交给了他。他每年都少一点自己。有天早上，他看着我，问我叫什么名字。

text.en: I left that night. ...If he asks your name, pilgrim — tell him. Somebody should.
text.zh: 我当晚就走了。……朝圣者，要是他问起你的名字——告诉他。总该有人告诉他。

text.en: Look at the stumps by the bridge. He drove thorns into the wood where the planks were. Like a man marking what is his.
text.zh: 你看桥边那些桩子。他把荆棘钉进了原来铺木板的地方。像是在给自己的东西做记号。

text.en: Aldo and Joss built that bridge the year before the river took Aldo. Every board I walk on, he cut.
text.zh: 那座桥是阿尔多和乔斯在河水带走阿尔多的前一年造的。我踩过的每一块木板，都是他亲手锯的。

text.en: Mend it. Then go and tell that knight whose bridge it was.
text.zh: 把它修好。然后去告诉那个骑士，那是谁的桥。

say.en: Is it me, or is the sun lower than it was this morning? It's barely afternoon. — And look: thorns along the road. Someone planted them, all in a line.
say.zh: 是我的错觉，还是太阳比早上低了？明明才刚过中午。——你看：路边全是荆棘。有人把它们种成了一排。

text.en: Stay where you are! ...You're alive. Sorry. Nothing alive comes up this road any more.
text.zh: 站住别动！……你是活人。抱歉。这条路上已经没有活的东西来过了。

text.en: The short days killed the wheat. Then the night things came. Then a knight in white rode through and took everything that shone — the hinges, the pans, my husband's ring off the gatepost.
text.zh: 白天太短，麦子都死了。然后夜里的东西来了。再后来，一个白衣骑士骑马经过，把所有会发光的东西都拿走了——门轴、锅、挂在门柱上的我丈夫的戒指。

text.en: The night the barn burned, a man in grey pulled me out of the smoke. Don't tell them in the village. They'd not understand.
text.zh: 谷仓着火那晚，是一个灰衣人把我从烟里拉了出来。别跟村里人说。他们不会明白的。

text.en: Pilgrim. Turn back.
text.zh: 朝圣者。回去吧。

text.en: (Something in his stillness says: not here. Not him. Not now.)
text.zh: （他那种静止的姿态在告诉你：不是这里。不是他。不是现在。）

text.en: Do you know what the seals hold? Your Church says they hold up the sky. They hold HIM. Astra. The First Night wears his face.
text.zh: 你知道那些印锁着的是什么吗？你的教会说它们撑着天。它们锁着的是他。阿斯特拉。初夜长着他的脸。

text.en: Every bearer you put down, he breathes easier. The night you see getting longer — that is him, waking up.
text.zh: 你每打倒一个持印者，他就喘得更轻松一点。你看到的那越来越长的夜——那就是他，正在醒来。

text.en: That's not true! The Church said— ...It isn't true. Is it?
text.zh: 不是真的！教会说过——……不是真的。对吧？

text.en: You of all of them should know, little one. ...No. You would not remember.
text.zh: 小家伙，在他们所有人里，你应该最清楚。……不。你不会记得了。

text.en: The knight past those thorns is a good man in a cage he did not choose. If you must go in, go. But when the crown comes off, what it lets go is mine.
text.zh: 那些荆棘后面的骑士，是一个被关进不由他选的笼子里的好人。你非进去不可，就去吧。但冠冕摘下时，它放出来的东西归我。

text.en: (A logbook lies open on the table, its pages stiff with cold. Columns of sunset times, year after year — each a little earlier than the last.)
text.zh: （桌上摊着一本日志，纸页冻得发硬。一栏栏日落时间，一年接一年——每一个都比上一个早一点。）

text.en: (The last page: "Found a small light asleep in the snow by the cairn, warm as a coal. It woke and asked me how old it was.")
text.zh: （最后一页："在石堆旁的雪里发现一点睡着的光，暖得像炭火。它醒了，问我它多大了。"）

text.en: A light in the snow? Huh. ...I don't remember any snow. I remember waking up and you being there. That's all.
text.zh: 雪里的光？嗯……我不记得什么雪。我只记得醒过来，然后你就在那儿了。就这些。

text.en: Somebody sat up here counting sunsets for years and nobody came to read it. That's the saddest book I ever saw.
text.zh: 有人在这儿坐了好多年，一天天数日落，却没有一个人来读。这是我见过最伤心的一本书。

say.en: The cows are all bunched up at the north end, away from the trees. Animals know things. What do they know?
say.zh: 牛都挤在北边，离树林远远的。动物是知道些什么的。它们知道什么呢？

text.en: (The light goes amber. One by one the cows fold their front legs and go down on their knees — every one of them facing east.)
text.zh: （天光转成琥珀色。牛一头接一头屈下前腿，跪了下去——全都朝着东边。）

text.en: Every dusk. Since the bridge went. My gran never saw a cow kneel in her life.
text.zh: 每天黄昏都这样。从桥断了以后就开始了。我奶奶活了一辈子都没见过牛下跪。

text.en: East is the Ford... and past the Ford, the road. Whatever is down that road, they're kneeling to it.
text.zh: 东边是渡口……过了渡口，就是那条大路。不管那条路上有什么，它们都在向它下跪。

text.en: And after dark, the dead come up out of the trees. Three cows this month. If you have a strong arm, come and find me.
text.zh: 天黑以后，死人就从树林里爬上来。这个月已经丢了三头牛。你要是有把子力气，来找我。

say.en: Listen. ...No birds. Not one. A forest this big should be loud in the afternoon.
say.zh: 你听。……没有鸟叫。一只都没有。这么大的森林，下午本该热热闹闹的。

text.en: (A camp nobody has used in a very long time: a tent gone to rags, a ring of cold stones, a cairn with a pilgrim's staff leaning on it.)
text.zh: （一处很久很久没人用过的营地：帐篷烂成了布条，一圈冷掉的石头，一座石冢，上面靠着一根朝圣杖。）

text.en: There's a paper on that tree. It says... "the Seal-bearers weaken. Let the pilgrimage be called." That's YOUR letter. Word for word.
text.zh: 那棵树上钉着一张纸。上面写着……"持印者渐衰，当发朝圣令。"这是你的那封信。一字不差。

text.en: Except it's old. Really old. And the name on it isn't yours.
text.zh: 只不过它很旧了。真的很旧。而且上面的名字不是你。

text.en: (Something glints by the cairn: a scallop shell on a cord. The pilgrim's mark. Sister Ilse would know whose it was.)
text.zh: （石冢旁有东西在闪：一枚穿着绳子的扇贝壳。朝圣者的标记。伊尔丝修女会知道它是谁的。）

text.en: (By the cold fire ring a pale shape is kneeling, head bowed, as if it has been kneeling for a long time.)
text.zh: （冷掉的火圈旁跪着一个苍白的影子，低着头，像是已经跪了很久很久。）

text.en: ("I knelt," it says, without looking up. "I knelt to him. Do not kneel.")
text.zh: （"我跪下了，"它说，没有抬头。"我向他跪下了。别跪。"）

text.en: It's gone. It was right THERE. ...Can we go now? Please?
text.zh: 它不见了。刚才明明就在那儿。……我们能走了吗？求你了？

say.en: Down there, past the thorns — the dead are sleeping badly. I can feel it from here, like a draught under a door.
say.zh: 下面，荆棘那边——那里的死人睡得很不安稳。我在这儿都能感觉到，像门缝底下灌进来的冷风。

say.en: Look at the carving on those stones: a knight with a crown of thorns, and people kneeling in front of him. Somebody important is buried down there. Fennick might know who.
say.zh: 你看那些石头上的刻纹：一个戴荆棘冠的骑士，前面跪着一排人。下面埋着很重要的人。芬尼克也许知道是谁。

say.en: Listen to that wheel — it keeps stopping, like it's tired. Tam says something got into his cellar. That's where the lamp oil is.
say.zh: 听那水车——转一会儿就停，像是累了。塔姆说有东西钻进了他的地窖。灯油就在那下面。

say.en: Slimes in the cellar — the night things come further in every week. The oil flasks are on the shelves at the back.
say.zh: 地窖里有史莱姆——夜里的东西一周比一周往里钻。油瓶在最里面的架子上。

say.en: This is where they say the sun came back, after the First Night. The flowers up here still face east, every one of them. Those must be the dawnbloom.
say.zh: 据说初夜之后，太阳就是在这里重新升起的。这里的花全都朝着东边，一朵不落。那些一定就是晨光花了。

text.en: (You take the old rope in both hands and pull. Far above, the bell swings once, twice — and its voice rolls down the hill toward Firstlight.)
text.zh: （你双手握住那根旧绳，用力一拉。高处的钟摆了一下，两下——钟声顺着山坡一路滚向初原村。）

text.en: They'll hear that in the village. ...It sounds like morning. Even though it isn't.
text.zh: 村里一定听得见。……听起来像早晨。虽然现在并不是。

text.en: The hearth here is where the Firstlight was lit. From the sun itself, Ilse says. It's so cold now. Like it's been waiting.
text.zh: 伊尔丝说，初火就是在这座火坛里点燃的，用的是太阳本身的光。现在它好冷。像是一直在等着什么。

say.en: Bones in every wall, and every one of them has a name over it. Knights. A whole order of knights, all down here together. ...They're not sleeping either.
say.zh: 每面墙里都是骨头，每一具上面都刻着名字。是骑士。一整个骑士团，全都埋在这下面。……他们也没在睡。

say.en: This niche has a name but nobody in it. "Fennick, squire to the Commander." Fennick — the old man on the bench in the village? And it's swept clean. Who comes down here to sweep a grave?
say.zh: 这个墓龛刻着名字，里面却是空的。"芬尼克，骑士长的侍从。"芬尼克——就是村里长凳上那个老人？而且扫得干干净净。谁会到这下面来扫一座墓？

text.en: Took your time. I came down looking for another way out and the dead herded me in here like a sheep.
text.zh: 你可真够慢的。我下来找别的出路，结果被那些死人像赶羊一样赶进了这里。

text.en: Read the roll on the altar, back there? Forty knights of some Order of the Thorn. The last name is cut deeper than the rest.
text.zh: 后面祭坛上那份名册你看了吗？四十来个什么荆棘骑士团的骑士。最后一个名字比别的刻得都深。

text.en: The thing that keeps this place is further down — the bottom of that stair in the north-east. I heard it walking all night. Back and forth. Like a guard on a wall.
text.zh: 看守这地方的东西在更下面——东北角那道楼梯的最底下。我听了一整夜它走路的声音。来来回回。就像城墙上的守卫。

say.en: It's standing guard in front of an altar. Not attacking — guarding. Whatever it was, it still thinks it has a post to keep.
say.zh: 它守在一座祭坛前面。不是在攻击——是在站岗。不管它生前是什么，它还以为自己有一个岗要守。

say.en: A statue — we can rest here. If I ever have more than one... power, this is where I could change it. It's so cold past those thorns. Colder than the shrine stone.
say.zh: 是雕像——我们可以在这里歇一下。要是我以后有不止一种……力量，就能在这里换。那些荆棘后面好冷。比路碑那里还冷。

text.en: Lina and Oskar are home. Firstlight gives thanks — to the flame that kept us, and to the one who walked into the barrow for us.
text.zh: 莉娜和奥斯卡回家了。初原村在此感恩——感谢守护我们的圣火，也感谢那位为我们走进古墓的人。

text.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment. It is the proof the debt is being paid. ...Go to your beds. The flame keeps the night.
text.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。苦难，是灾厄得以被偿还的证明。……回去睡吧。圣火会守着夜晚。

text.en: (A man in a grey cloak stands at the flame. Ash on his hands. He lifts the fire into a hooded lantern as if it weighs nothing.)
text.zh: （一个披灰斗篷的男人站在圣火前。他手上沾着灰。他把火捧进一盏带罩的提灯里，仿佛它轻得没有重量。）

text.en: Thief! Stop — THIEF!
text.zh: 有贼！站住——抓贼！

text.en: ...Not tonight.
text.zh: ……今晚不行。

text.en: He looked at me. Why did he look at me like that?
text.zh: 他看了我一眼。他为什么那样看我？

text.en: Gone east — over the river. Over the river! He froze it under his feet and walked across.
text.zh: 往东跑了——过了河。过了河！他让河水在脚下结冰，就那么走过去了。

text.en: By order of the Holy City: the Seal-bearers fail. The Long Night returns. Let the pilgrimage be called.
text.zh: 奉圣城之命：持印者正在衰败。极夜正在回归。朝圣就此发起。

text.en: One has come down from the mountain with a fairy at their side. The Church names them pilgrim.
text.zh: 有一人带着精灵从山上下来。教会封其为朝圣者。

text.en: (The courier stares at Pip a long moment, and says nothing.)
text.zh: （信使盯着小啾看了很久，什么也没说。）

text.en: The flame is gone and the Church calls you in the same night. I do not believe in coincidence, pilgrim. Come to me when you are ready.
text.zh: 圣火被夺走的同一夜，教会就召唤了你。我不相信巧合，朝圣者。准备好了就来找我。

text.en: (A field ringed with thorns. Stones carved as kneeling pilgrims. In the middle, a knight in white, a crown of briars grown through his helm.)
text.zh: （一片被荆棘围起来的田野。石头被雕成跪着的朝圣者。正中间，一位白衣骑士，荆棘冠长进了他的头盔。）

text.en: None cross that do not kneel.
text.zh: 不跪者，不得过。

text.en: Another pilgrim. They always send another.
text.zh: 又一个朝圣者。他们总是再派一个来。

text.en: I hold. I... hold. I do not remember what. Kneel.
text.zh: 我守着。我……守着。我不记得守的是什么了。跪下。

text.en: He's so sad. Why does that make me want to cry? Be careful — when he plants his sword, the thorns come up in a ring!
text.zh: 他好难过。为什么我看着也想哭？小心——他把剑插进地里的时候，荆棘会长成一圈！

text.en: (The knight kneels. For the first time in a long while he lifts the crown from his own head, and holds it out.)
text.zh: （骑士跪了下来。很久以来第一次，他亲手把荆棘冠从头上摘下，递了出来。）

text.en: ("Take it. It was never mine to hold.")
text.zh: （"拿去吧。它本就不该由我戴着。"）

text.en: (Something comes loose from the crown — a cold light — and runs to Pip like water finding an old riverbed.)
text.zh: （有什么东西从荆棘冠上散开——一道冷光——像水找到了旧河床一样，流向了小啾。）

text.en: It came to me! It's warm — no, cold — no, it's mine? Is that allowed?
text.zh: 它朝我来了！暖暖的——不对，凉凉的——不对，它是我的？可以这样吗？

text.en: ...So it has started.
text.zh: ……原来已经开始了。

text.en: (The grey man opens his lantern. The rest of the light goes into the stolen flame. It gutters gold; his hand shakes.)
text.zh: （灰衣人打开了提灯。剩下的光流进了被夺走的圣火。火焰一阵金黄，他的手在发抖。）

text.en: Every seal you break makes the night longer. Ask your Church why.
text.zh: 你每打破一道印，夜就更长一分。去问问你的教会为什么。

text.en: Keep what the little one caught. Go home. Tell Rowan the light is safer with me than with you.
text.zh: 那只小家伙接住的，你就留着。回去吧。告诉罗万，光在我这里比在你们那里安全。

text.en: The Crown of Thorns. In Firstlight. ...And the heretic still has our flame.
text.zh: 荆棘冠。在初原村。……可那个异端还拿着我们的火。

text.en: He always did carry things that were too heavy for him.
text.zh: 他从小就总是背着对他来说太重的东西。

text.en: Four minutes. The sun set four minutes early tonight. I am sure it means nothing.
text.zh: 四分钟。今晚太阳早落了四分钟。我相信这什么都不代表。

card.en:
CHAPTER ONE · THE FIRST SEAL

The White Knight knelt, and gave up the Crown.
The grey man took the light east.
And the night came a little sooner.
card.zh:
第一章 · 第一印

白骑士跪下，交出了荆棘冠。
灰衣人带着光往东去了。
而夜晚，来得更早了一些。

text.en: (Among the thorns where the knight fell, one is still green. It is warm, and it hums, very faintly, like a door left open.)
text.zh: （骑士倒下的荆棘丛里，有一根还是绿的。它是温热的，还在很轻很轻地嗡鸣，像一扇没关严的门。）

text.en: It wants to be used. On you, I think — hold it and right click yourself. I can hear a field on the other side of it. And... somebody waiting.
text.zh: 它想被用一下。对你用，我觉得——拿着它右键点你自己。我能听见它另一边有一片田野。还有……有人在等。

text.en: You came. ...You are the one who took the crown off me. I could not see your face then. I can now.
text.zh: 你来了。……你就是替我摘下冠冕的人。那时候我看不清你的脸。现在能看清了。

text.en: I swore I would hold until I was relieved. You relieved me. So I hold for you now — this ground, as far as the mist. It is yours: build, sow, keep beasts.
text.zh: 我发过誓，要坚守到有人来接替我。你接替了我。所以现在换我为你坚守——这片土地，一直到迷雾那里。它是你的了：盖房、播种、养牲口都行。

text.en: Bring me what a wider ground needs, and I will push the mist back. ...And tell me your name. I would like to keep one, this time.
text.zh: 把扩建所需的东西带给我，我就把迷雾推远。……还有，告诉我你的名字。这一次，我想记住一个名字。

text.en: He looks so different without the helmet. Kind. ...Tired, but kind.
text.zh: 他不戴头盔，看起来完全不一样了。很和善。……很累，但很和善。

text.en: Here — the coin of this ground. My stall keeps seeds, feed and bait; it buys back what you grow, raise and catch. The pond is full of fish.
text.zh: 给——这是这片土地的钱币。我的货摊卖种子、饲料和鱼饵，也收你种的、养的、钓的东西。池塘里鱼可多了。

say.en: The mist pulled back! There's a grove out there, and stones.
say.zh: 迷雾退开了！那边有一片树林，还有石头。

say.en: Further again — a meadow, and water. It's getting to be a real place.
say.zh: 又远了一圈——一片草地，还有水。这里越来越像个真正的家了。

say.en: All of it now. Boundary stones at the edges... and iron in the rocks.
say.zh: 全都打开了。边上有界石……岩石里还有铁。

text.en: (Everything here burned — the hay, the orchard, the hen house. The house alone still stands.)
text.zh: （这里的一切都烧光了——干草、果园、鸡舍。只剩那座房子还立着。）

text.en: (Marks in the ash, each longer than my arm. Claws.)
text.zh: （灰烬里有印子，每一道都比我的胳膊还长。是爪痕。）

text.en: (Emberfall. Half its roofs are new thatch; the rest are still black.)
text.zh: （余烬镇。一半的屋顶是新铺的茅草，另一半还是黑的。）

text.en: You came up the east road. Then you saw the farm.
text.zh: 你是从东大路上来的。那你看见那座农庄了。

text.en: A dragon nests on Cinder Peak, up the pass east of here. Every spring it comes down. This spring it came down twice.
text.zh: 烬峰上住着一头魔龙，就在镇东的山道上面。每年春天它都下山一回。今年春天，它下来了两回。

text.en: Garrick the smith has a pattern for a blade that can cut its hide. He needs iron and coal from the old mine.
text.zh: 铁匠加里克有一把能砍穿龙皮的剑的图样。他缺铁和煤，旧矿坑里有。

text.en: And Wren, our herbalist, knows a draught against fire. Bring them what they ask — and take this bread. Nobody fights hungry.
text.zh: 我们的草药师雷恩会熬一种防火的药。把他们要的东西带去——再拿上这些面包。饿着肚子可打不了仗。

text.en: (Dragonsbane at my side, the draughts in my pack. The pass east of the village climbs to Cinder Peak.)
text.zh: （屠龙剑在身侧，药剂在行囊里。镇东的山道一直通到烬峰。）

text.en: (Heat, and the smell of scorched stone. Something vast breathes in the dark.)
text.zh: （一股热浪，还有烧焦石头的气味。有个庞然大物在黑暗里呼吸。）

text.en: (It is over. The fire in the lair is going out.)
text.zh: （结束了。巢穴里的火正在熄灭。）

card.en:
THE DRAGON OF CINDER PEAK

The dragon is dead.
Emberfall will sleep tonight, and the road east is open.

Everything the world learned from you is in the Threadbook (J).
card.zh:
烬峰魔龙

魔龙死了。
今夜余烬镇可以安睡，东边的路也通了。

世界从你身上学到的一切，都记在织线簿里（J）。

text.en: Hesper's ferry is mended with a rope: while the winch is broken, a rope must exist somewhere at the ford.
text.zh: 赫斯珀的渡船要靠一根绳子来修：绞盘没修好之前，渡口总得有一根绳子。

text.en: That was my last good rope. … No — there is the old one off the raft. Frayed, but it will splice.
text.zh: 那是我最后一根好绳子。……不对——筏子上还拆下来一根旧的。磨毛了，但还能接。

text.en: There must always be some way across the river: rope for the ferry, the dead tree to fell, or frost to freeze the water.
text.zh: 过河总得有条路：修渡船的绳子、能砍倒的枯树，或者能冻住河水的寒气。

text.en: The water is dropping. Come, I will take you over on the raft myself, line or no line.
text.zh: 水在退了。来，不管有没有渡绳，我亲自撑筏送你过去。
